+def extend_reservation(store: Store, reservation_id: int, new_end: date) -> Reservation:
+    """Move the exclusive ``end`` of an active reservation to a later date.
+
+    Only the added days ``[current end, new end)`` are checked for conflicts, so a
+    reservation never conflicts with itself and extending up to the start of the next
+    booking is allowed.
+    """
+    reservation = get_reservation(store, reservation_id)
+    if reservation.status is not ReservationStatus.ACTIVE:
+        raise ConflictError(
+            f"Reservation {reservation_id} is {reservation.status.value} and cannot be extended"
+        )
+    if new_end <= reservation.end:
+        raise InvalidRequestError("New end must be after the current end")
+    if (new_end - reservation.start).days > MAX_RENTAL_DAYS:
+        raise InvalidRequestError(f"Reservations are limited to {MAX_RENTAL_DAYS} days")
+
+    conflicts = [
+        r
+        for r in find_conflicts(
+            store, reservation.item_id, reservation.end, new_end, exclude_id=reservation.id
+        )
+        if r.status is ReservationStatus.ACTIVE
+    ]
+    if conflicts:
+        ids = ", ".join(str(r.id) for r in conflicts)
+        raise ConflictError(
+            f"Item {reservation.item_id} is already reserved (reservations: {ids})"
+        )
+
+    extended = reservation.model_copy(update={"end": new_end})

+"""Scheduled maintenance windows: date ranges during which an item cannot be rented."""
+
+from app.errors import ConflictError
+from app.models import (
+    MaintenanceWindow,
+    MaintenanceWindowCreate,
+    ReservationStatus,
+)
+from app.services.availability import ranges_overlap, validate_range
+from app.services.catalog import get_item
+from app.storage import Store
+
+
+def list_maintenance_windows(store: Store, item_id: int) -> list[MaintenanceWindow]:
+    """The item's windows ordered by ``start`` ascending, then by ``id``."""
+    get_item(store, item_id)
+    windows = store.maintenance_windows.for_item(item_id)
+    return sorted(windows, key=lambda w: (w.start, w.id))
+
+
+def create_maintenance_window(
+    store: Store, item_id: int, data: MaintenanceWindowCreate
+) -> MaintenanceWindow:
+    """Schedule a maintenance window for an item.
+
+    The range must be non-empty and must not overlap an active reservation of the item.
+    """
+    validate_range(data.start, data.end)
+    item = get_item(store, item_id)
+
+    for reservation in store.reservations.for_item(item.id):
+        if reservation.status is not ReservationStatus.ACTIVE:
+            continue
+        if ranges_overlap(reservation.start, reservation.end, data.start, data.end):
+            raise ConflictError(
+                f"Item {item.id} has an active reservation overlapping this period "
+                f"(reservation: {reservation.id})"
+            )
+
+    return store.maintenance_windows.create(data, item_id=item.id)
